faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DMRC Supervisor (P. Way) posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the DMRC Supervisor (P. Way) posts is 15th September 2026. Candidates are advised to send their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the eligibility criteria for DMRC Supervisor (P. Way) recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must be working in or retired from Indian Railways with experience in the P.Way department. They should be conversant with computerized environments and free from D&AR and Vigilance angles. A minimum of 5 years of supervisory experience is also required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the DMRC Supervisor (P. Way) posts?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Supervisor (P. Way) posts is between a minimum of 55 years and a maximum of 62 years as of 1st August 2026. No age relaxation details are provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the DMRC Supervisor (P. Way) positions?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary ranges from Rs. 56,300/- to Rs. 72,600/- per month, depending on the retired grade of the candidate. Specific amounts are Rs. 72,600/-, Rs. 65,800/-, and Rs. 56,300/-.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Supervisor (P. Way) post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies for the Supervisor (P. Way) post in the Delhi Metro Rail Corporation (DMRC) recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for DMRC Supervisor (P. Way) recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the DMRC Supervisor (P. Way) posts includes a Personal Interview followed by a Medical Fitness Examination. Candidates must clear both stages to be considered for the position.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for DMRC Supervisor (P. Way) posts?
faq.answer: As per the official notification, there is no application fee mentioned for the DMRC Supervisor (P. Way) recruitment. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the DMRC Supervisor (P. Way) recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and send it via Speed Post or email to the specified address/email ID.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and relevant certificates along with the filled application form. Specific details will be in the official notification.
